description: fz rejects the parenthesised keyword form of quote: 'defmacro one() do quote(do: 1 + 0) end' fails with 'parse/expected-token: expected do, got LParen'. Elixir accepts quote(do: expr); it is the common one-line form (verified with the elixir CLI: defmacro one(), do: quote(do: 1) returns 1). Fix at the parser: quote with a parenthesised keyword list is the same call as quote do: expr, with no second path. Done when: a fixture using quote(do: 1 + 0) inside a macro asserts its value, and fails first. One commit.
title: quote(do: expr) parses, as in Elixir
